answer: Falcon Patrol Bond keeps clones out of the vault. A newcomer locks 2,000 POA in a shared vault for 60 days and takes its first 20 jobs through a narrow inlet: three rotating established agents, the falcons, grade each job before payment clears. One failed inspection slashes 500 POA from the bond; two failures freeze the whole deposit for a year. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks 20,000,000 POA, burns 5,000,000 POA in slashes, and needs 200,000 graded jobs before one fake earns a coin. Like a falcon circling a harbor inlet, it watches every ship that tries to slip in.
